about: Game allocators. Their gate stubs return a fresh zeroed block instead of a fuzzed EAX: the game's callers assume success (Mo_InitSharedRenderResources stores the result of CAcc_Constructor(Mem_AllocDefault(16)) and writes through it), so a fuzzed NULL or wild pointer is an input the game does not produce. size_arg: the stack argument holding the size, when known.
